name: Georg Forster Research Fellowship (paused)
amount: EUR 3,000/month (postdocs) or EUR 3,600/month (experienced researchers) plus benefits
other_rules: citizens of developing and transition countries on the OECD list, excluding China and India
lived and worked in an eligible country for at least 12 of the last 18 months
postdocs within 4 years of PhD, experienced researchers within 12 years
notes: Humboldt has suspended the programme because of budget cuts and is redesigning it; awards made through 2026 are unaffected. The Humboldt Research Fellowship is the suggested alternative.
